Midnight Cocoa

Served at: Polaris Meteor Watch & UFO Evening

Serves 4-6Prep 5 minCook 10-15 min

This rich, dark cocoa is the perfect companion for a celestial evening. Its deep chocolate notes and warm embrace make it ideal for warding off the chill as you gaze at meteor showers or scan the skies for unidentified flying objects, adding a touch of cozy magic to your Polaris Meteor Watch. It's a comforting classic, elevated for an extraordinary night under the stars.

Ingredients

  • 4 cups (960 ml) whole milk, or preferred milk alternative
  • 1/2 cup (50 g) unsweetened cocoa powder, Dutch-processed for a darker color
  • 1/2 cup (100 g) granulated sugar, or to taste
  • 4 ounces (113 g) dark chocolate (60-70% cacao), finely chopped
  • 1 teaspoon (5 ml) pure vanilla extract
  • Pinch of salt
  • Optional garnishes: whipped cream, mini marshmallows, chocolate shavings, edible glitter

Method

  1. In a medium saucepan, whisk together the unsweetened cocoa powder, granulated sugar, and salt until well combined.
  2. Gradually add about 1/2 cup (120 ml) of the milk to the dry ingredients, whisking constantly to form a smooth, lump-free paste.
  3. Pour in the remaining 3 1/2 cups (840 ml) of milk and place the saucepan over medium heat.
  4. Heat the mixture, stirring occasionally, until it is hot and steaming but not boiling. Do not allow it to come to a full boil.
  5. Remove the saucepan from the heat and add the finely chopped dark chocolate. Let it sit for 1-2 minutes to soften.
  6. Whisk the cocoa mixture until the chocolate is completely melted and the drink is smooth and creamy.
  7. Stir in the vanilla extract.
  8. Taste and adjust sugar if desired.
  9. Ladle the Midnight Cocoa into mugs and serve immediately, garnished with your favorite toppings.

Tips

  • For an adult version, add a splash of coffee liqueur, peppermint schnapps, or dark rum to each mug before serving.
  • To evoke a 'spicy alien' theme, add a tiny pinch of cayenne pepper or a cinnamon stick to the pot while heating the milk.
  • For a truly stellar presentation, top with whipped cream and a sprinkle of edible silver or gold glitter, or finely grated white chocolate to resemble stars.
